Name: delaySampling
Requirement: Round-trip delay shall be sampled from 6 to 10 s. Rover state and status messages shall update every 60 s, with message delays handled as timed events.

Name: commandHandshake
Requirement: The rover shall not start a new waypoint without a command, or while Earth is out of view. A command with no acknowledgement within 10 s shall be resent, and a dropped status message is replaced by the next one. Drops and resends shall be logged.

Name: visibilityFromTerrain
Requirement: Sun and Earth visibility shall be calculated from terrain, not hand-painted.

Name: visibilityHeights
Requirement: Earth visibility shall use 2 m height and sunlight 1 m height (both assumed).

Name: roadOnlyChangesFlags
Requirement: Turning the road off shall change only the road flags.

Name: footprintAndWheels
Requirement: The rover shall fit a 170 mm x 170 mm footprint with 50 mm x 20 mm wheels, within 2 mm.

Name: massLimit
Requirement: Mass shall stay under 0.8 kg, so the torque margins in the spec hold.

Name: viperFeatures
Requirement: The rover shall carry VIPER's recognisable features: a box body, a wheel at each corner, panels on the rear, left and right, and a front mast.

Name: printable
Requirement: All structural parts shall print in PLA on a 180 mm x 180 mm bed without supports.

Name: levelSpeed
Requirement: The rover shall hold a commanded speed of 2 cm/s on level ground, within 10%.

Name: slopeAndTurn
Requirement: The rover shall climb a 15 degree slope and turn on the spot on the chosen demo surface.

Name: endurance
Requirement: The rover shall run for at least 2 hours of continuous driving on one set of cells.

Name: wifiCommanding
Requirement: The rover shall accept waypoint commands over Wi-Fi and report position, heading and battery voltage.

Name: safeStop
Requirement: The rover shall stop within 1 s if commands stop arriving.

Name: cost
Requirement: Total parts cost shall stay under GBP 300, including filament and delivery.

Name: roadSpeedAndSlip
Requirement: Speed made good and slip shall use the no-road values off-road, and the active preset on road cells.

Name: slopeLimit
Requirement: The planner shall reject cells above the 15 degree slope limit.

Name: headingForSun
Requirement: Body heading may differ from travel direction by up to 50 degrees while driving. In sunlight the rover shall choose the allowed heading with the most solar input; in shadow it shall face its direction of travel.

Name: comparison
Requirement: The MVP shall compare the same VIPER-class rover trip with and without a road, on real lunar south polar terrain, and report the difference in time, energy, risk and reliability.

Name: reportEitherWay
Requirement: Results shall be reported whichever way they turn out, including if the road makes little difference.

Name: caveat
Requirement: Every shared result shall state that it comes from a simplified model using assumed rover loads, slip and road performance.

Name: loadModel
Requirement: Load shall be the awake load, plus driving power multiplied by the moving fraction.

Name: chargeBounds
Requirement: Charge shall stay between 0% and 100%, with excess solar power discarded.

Name: timeAndEnergy
Requirement: The planner shall work out time and energy from the active speed, slip and load.

Name: hardLimits
Requirement: Hard limits shall be slope, battery reserve, and no driving without Earth in view.

Name: arrivalObjective
Requirement: The planner shall minimise arrival time, with an energy penalty of 0.001 h per Wh drawn from the battery (assumed and configurable).

Name: planTime
Requirement: The planner may use a coarser grid, but each plan shall finish within 5 min and the final route shall be rechecked at full resolution.
